JavaScript already recognizes the _createParticular call shape, but preflightCreation() refuses that shape at its separate shopkeeper gate before placement. The correct owner is makemon.c:makemon, not teleport.c:collect_coords; coordinate collection is the next already-ported callee that C reaches.

JS preflightCreation() has an explicit createParticularCall marker for this source shape but the PM_SHOPKEEPER guard does not exempt it.
